# EventTrellan

> EventTrellan is a per-event launch-asset service: event microsites, coordinated invitations, reminder plans, and promo kits, sold per event. It is operated under Apex Grid Engineering PLLC.

## What EventTrellan does
- A customer supplies their event facts (name, host, date, time with time zone, venue or online format, description, RSVP instructions) in a single event brief.
- EventTrellan drafts a mobile-ready event microsite, an invitation set (email + short message version), a reminder plan, and — by tier — a social promo kit and run-of-show template.
- Nothing publishes without the customer confirming their details: every date, time, place, and detail is shown back to the customer for explicit approval before publication. EventTrellan never invents or silently corrects event facts.

## What EventTrellan is not
- Not an event planner: no venue booking, staffing, vendor coordination, insurance, or attendance guarantees.
- Not a ticketing service: it sells no tickets and collects no ticket money.
- At launch, EventTrellan prepares invitation and reminder materials; the organizer sends them through their own channels.

## Pricing (per event, test pricing)
- Essentials — $29 per event: publication of one approved event microsite, one invitation set, basic reminder plan.
- Launch — $79 per event: Essentials plus social promotion copy pack, multiple microsite themes, an additional reminder touch.
- Signature — $149 per event: Launch plus expanded audience messaging and a custom run-of-show template.
